Email sent September 13, 2026, at 6:51 p.m. to Mayor Marc Citrin, the Village Board of Trustees, John Ledwith, and the Village Clerk. Public copy omits email addresses and Bcc recipients.

Request for August 20, 2026 Board of Trustees Meeting Recording

Dear Mayor Citrin, Trustees, Mr. Ledwith, and Village Clerk:

I am writing to request the direct public link to the recording of the August 20, 2026 Board of Trustees meeting.

The Village’s news archive currently lists Board of Trustees meeting videos through July 16, 2026, but I have not been able to locate the August 20 recording. That recording is important to the public and legislative record because I spoke during public comment to object to the proposed law affecting accessory structures, boathouses, and docks.

During that exchange, Mayor Citrin stated that the proposed law arose from the photoshoot at our boathouse and may affect other boathouses and docks, including the Tuxedo Club Boathouse. Because that statement directly relates to the origin, purpose, and factual basis of the proposed legislation, the public should be able to review the complete exchange.

Please send me the direct link to the complete August 20, 2026 meeting recording.

Thank you for your prompt attention.

Respectfully,
